title: Announce first attainment of 100 percent exactly once
summary: When a project, phase, milestone, task or feature first reaches 100 percent, show its completion and percentage once in the reporting conversation.
statement: When a project, phase, milestone, task or feature first reaches 100 percent, show its completion and percentage once in the reporting conversation.
rationale: Public-safe, scoped project-development requirement normalized from an independently authorized specimen.

conditions: The project or roadmap item reaches and is first reported at 100 percent.
exceptions: Historical completion events should not be reannounced as new completions.
